subject: Bolero of Fire
text: Adult Link learns the Bolero of Fire on the way to the Fire Temple in the Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: Make your way to the Death Mountain...Crater as Adult Link on the way to the...Fire Temple and you'll learn this one.

subject: Bolero of Fire
text: The Bolero of Fire is designed solely for warping Link back to the Fire Temple.

evidence.quote: This song is designed solely for the...purpose of warping you back to a dungeon,...in this case it's the Fire Temple.

subject: Epona's Song
text: Link learns Epona's Song by speaking with Malon and playing the Ocarina along with her at Lon Lon Ranch after Hyrule Castle.

evidence.quote: At Lon Lon Ranch after Hyrule Castle,...speak with Malon and play the Ocarina...along with her to learn this song.

subject: Epona's Song
text: Playing Epona's Song while standing beside a cow causes the cow to give free Lon Lon Milk.

evidence.quote: Among other uses, when you play this...song while standing beside a cow, the...cow will give you free Lon Lon Milk.

subject: Minuet of Forest
text: Adult Link automatically learns the Minuet of Forest before entering the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: When you are Adult Link and heading for...the Forest Temple, you will automatically...learn this song before you go inside.

subject: Minuet of Forest
text: The Minuet of Forest is designed solely for warping Link back to the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: This song is designed solely for the...purpose of warping you back to a dungeon,...in this case it's the Fire Temple.

subject: Nocturne of Shadow
text: Adult Link learns the Nocturne of Shadow by returning to Kakariko Village after completing the Water Temple.

evidence.quote: When you are Adult Link and have finished...the Water Temple, head back to...Kakariko Village to learn this song.

subject: Nocturne of Shadow
text: The Nocturne of Shadow is designed to warp Link to the Shadow Temple in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: This song is designed solely for the...purpose of warping you, in this case to...the Shadow Temple in Kakariko Village.

subject: Prelude of Light
text: Adult Link learns the Prelude of Light upon returning to the Temple of Time after finishing the Forest Temple.

evidence.quote: When you are Adult Link and have finished...the Forest Temple, head back to the...Temple of Time to learn this song.

subject: Prelude of Light
text: The Prelude of Light is designed to warp Link to the Temple of Time in Hyrule Market.

evidence.quote: This song is designed solely for the...purpose of warping you, in this case to...the Temple of Time in Hyrule Market.

subject: Requiem of Spirit
text: Link automatically acquires the Requiem of Spirit after visiting the Spirit Temple as an adult and leaving.

evidence.quote: You will acquire this after you first...visit the Spirit Temple as an adult and...then leave, happens automatically.

subject: Requiem of Spirit
text: The Requiem of Spirit is designed solely for warping Link back to the Spirit Temple.

evidence.quote: This song is designed solely for the...purpose of warping you back to a dungeon,...in this case it's the Spirit Temple.

subject: Saria's Song
text: Saria teaches Link Saria's Song when reached in the Sacred Meadow through the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Head to the Lost Woods and make your way...through to the Sacred Meadow to find...Saria and she will teach it to you.

subject: Saria's Song
text: Playing Saria's Song awards Link a Piece of Heart in the forest among other uses.

evidence.quote: A universal use song first tought to...you by Saria, and nets you, among other...things a Piece of Heart in the forest.

subject: Scarecrow's Song
text: Link can create the Scarecrow's Song by playing any custom song for the scarecrow found at Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: When you make it to Lake Hylia, there...you will find a scarecrow.  Play a song...for it, anything you want to make it.

subject: Scarecrow's Song
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song summons Pierre the scarecrow at specific spots to act as a Hookshot target.

evidence.quote: This song is designed to allow you to...summon Pierre the scarecrow at certain...points, he becomes a Hookshot target.

subject: Serenade of Water
text: Link is taught the Serenade of Water after navigating through the Ice Cavern and defeating the miniboss.

evidence.quote: You must first navigate through the...Ice Cavern and then after the miniboss...you will be taight this song.

subject: Serenade of Water
text: The Serenade of Water is designed solely to warp Link back to the Water Temple.

evidence.quote: This song is designed solely for the...purpose of warping you back to a dungeon,...in this case it's the Water Temple.

subject: Song of Storms
text: Adult Link learns the Song of Storms by playing the Ocarina in front of the man inside the Kakariko Village windmill.

evidence.quote: When you are Adult Link, head to the...windmill in Kakariko Village and play...your Ocarina in front of the guy there.

subject: Song of Storms
text: Playing the Song of Storms outside creates a large storm in the sky.

evidence.quote: This song is designed to create a...large storm in the sky when played...outside, also has minimal practical use.

subject: Song of Time
text: After gathering all three sacred stones, Zelda gives Link the Ocarina of Time and teaches him the Song of Time.

evidence.quote: After collecting all three sacred stones,...you will be give the Ocarina of Time...by Zelda and then she teaches you this.

subject: Song of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time in front of the altar in the Temple of Time enables Link to alter the flow of time.

evidence.quote: Use it in front of the altar in the...Temple of Time and Link will be...able to alter the flow of time.

subject: Sun's Song
text: Link finds the Sun's Song inside the Royal Tomb in Kakariko Village after playing Zelda's Lullaby on it at night.

evidence.quote: In Kakariko Village at night, play...Zelda's Lullaby on the Royal Tomb...and go inside to find the song.

subject: Sun's Song
text: Playing the Sun's Song changes day to night or night to day.

evidence.quote: Changes the sun's position, if it's...day then it will turn to night, if...it's night then it will turn to day.

subject: Zelda's Lullaby
text: Impa teaches Link Zelda's Lullaby after speaking with her following the meeting with Princess Zelda in the castle garden.

evidence.quote: After meeting with Princess Zelda in the...caslte garden, speak with Impa and...she will teach you how to play this song.

subject: Zelda's Lullaby
text: Zelda's Lullaby is played to prove connections to the royal family.

evidence.quote: Any circumstance where a royal tune...may be appropriate to prove your...connections to the royal family.

subject: Defense Upgrade
text: A Great Fairy Fountain with the Defense Upgrade is located outside Ganon's Castle after obtaining the Golden Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: You will find this Great Fairy Fountain...outside of Ganon's Castle after you...acquire the Golden Gauntlets.

subject: Defense Upgrade
text: The Defense Upgrade gives hearts a white outline and doubles Link's total health.

evidence.quote: What this does it outline all of your...hearts with a white outline that doubles...your total health, very very helpful.

subject: Din's Fire
text: Din's Fire is found in a passageway revealed by blowing up a rock on the right just past the gate at Hyrule Castle.

evidence.quote: Head back to Hyrule Castle, just past...the gate on the right there is a rock...to blow up and reveal the passageway.

subject: Din's Fire
text: Din's Fire is equipped to a C button and activated by pressing that button when having enough magic.

evidence.quote: Equip it in the menu to one of the...C buttons and when you have enough...magic, press that C button to use it.

subject: Farore's Wind
text: In Zora's Fountain, blowing up the wall reveals the Great Fairy's Fountain where the Great Fairy teaches Farore's Wind.

evidence.quote: In Zora's Fountain, blow up the wall...to reveal the Great Fairy's Fountain...and she teaches it to you there.

subject: Farore's Wind
text: Farore's Wind creates a warp point in a dungeon that can be used to warp back or establish a new point.

evidence.quote: It creates a special warp point in a...dungeon and then then be used to either...warp to that point, or make a new one.

subject: Nayru's Love
text: As Adult Link, blowing up a wall on the north side between two trees just before the Spirit Temple reveals Nayru's Love.

evidence.quote: Just before the Spirit Temple as Adult...Link, on the north side between two trees...there is a wall for you to blow up.

subject: Nayru's Love
text: Nayru's Love creates a temporary barrier around Link making him invulnerable.

evidence.quote: This magic creates a special barrier...around Link rendering him unvulnerable,...however the barrier is only temporary.

subject: Spin Attack
text: The Spin Attack is acquired in the Great Fairy's Fountain located above Goron City on the Death Mountain Trail using the Bomb Bag.

evidence.quote: Inside the Great Fairy's Fountain...located above the Goron City on the...Death Mountain Trail, need Bomb Bag.

subject: Spin Attack
text: To perform a Spin Attack, hold down the B button until a blue and then an orange aura appears around Link's sword, then let go.

evidence.quote: Hold down the B button and hold it, a...blue aura appears around Link's sword and...then an orange one.  Now let go.
